program.name: Bachelor International Business
specialization: International focus options include Asia-Pacific, Arabic Countries and the Middle East, Russia and Eastern Europe, Spain and Latin America, France and Francophone Countries, and Germany and European Union.

notes: The written application requires an authenticated school leaving certificate, or alternatively the last three school reports.
Applicants can submit the school leaving certificate by the start of studies at the latest.
Official page names TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo, Cambridge, and ELS 112 as acceptable proof routes, but does not expose exact score thresholds in the reviewed page text.
Internship proof is required only for lateral entry into the third semester.

documents: Authenticated copy of school leaving certificate, alternatively last three school reports
Proof of English language skills B2 by start of studies
Scholarship personal statement when applying for a scholarship
conditional_paths: Transfer students may need advanced knowledge in a second foreign language depending on international focus.
Lateral entry into the third semester requires internship proof and a document of good academic standing.
The Pre-Bachelor program is presented as a preparation route, not as a degree record here.
international_requirements: Non-EU nationals are required to apply for a student visa after acceptance.
For visa invitation letter steps, MBS asks for the signed study contract, passport details page, enrollment fee, and deposit.

deadlines: Monthly application rounds: January 15, February 15, March 15, April 15, May 15, June 15, July 15, August 15, September 15, October 15, November 15, and December 15.
Transfer students: November 30 for spring term entry; June 30 for fall term entry.
fees: Enrollment fee after acceptance: EUR 690; international students EUR 1,490

key_findings: MBS English master programs share a common admissions core: 180 ECTS Bachelor's degree, business/economics direct entry, Pre-Master route for non-economics backgrounds, and the same English-test thresholds.

The earlier crawler warning about missing MBS language tests is confirmed as important: official master and MBA pages list TOEFL 85, IELTS 6.5, ELS 112, Duolingo 115, PTE 56, and Cambridge 173/Grade B.
No official GMAT/GRE requirement was found on the reviewed MBS Bachelor, Master, MBA, or DBA pages.
MBA General Management requires at least two years of pertinent post-degree work experience; DBA requires a Master's degree plus five years of work experience including three managerial years.
Master International Business has February and September starts; the other reviewed English master programs start in September.
known_gaps: Bachelor English B2 proof is stated, but exact TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo/Cambridge score thresholds were not found in the reviewed page text.
Master program application fees were not found on the reviewed master pages.
DBA application can be submitted any time, but specific application-round dates were not found.
Pre-Bachelor and Pre-Master are captured only as preparation/conditional pathways, not as degree-program records.
